boundaries: All Git-writing commands use the private index environment; immutable objects are intentionally written to the shared object store only by a later root-authorized --apply.
The new non-branch ref uses no-deref and compare-and-swap from zero; existing normal or symbolic refs are refused.
Failures may leave unreachable objects or a private index. No shared state rollback is performed.
Other actors may change shared HEAD/index/branches during a real run; receipt records observed drift without reverting it.
